course_title: Feature Engineering for NLP in Python
course_description: Successfully completed 'Feature Engineering for NLP in Python' on DataCamp, where I applied advanced text processing techniques such as POS tagging, named entity recognition, and tf-idf modeling using scikit-learn and spaCy. Built sentiment predictors, document similarity tools, and recommendation systems, showcasing the ability to extract and engineer valuable features from raw text for real-world machine learning applications.

Completed 'Advanced NLP with spaCy' on DataCamp, gaining hands-on experience with spaCy’s industry-grade NLP capabilities. Mastered core operations like tokenization, parsing, and named entity recognition, while also building custom pipelines, matching patterns, and training models for real-world text analysis. This course sharpened my ability to structure unstructured data and apply powerful NLP workflows in production-ready environments.

course_title: Introduction to Natural Language Processing in Python
course_description: Completed Introduction to Natural Language Processing in Python on DataCamp. Gained foundational skills in NLP, including tokenization, topic modeling, and text classification. Built a fake news classifier and explored essential tools like NLTK and deep learning libraries to solve real-world text processing problems. This course strengthened my ability to analyze and extract meaning from raw text using Python.

Completed Hyperparameter Tuning in Python on DataCamp. Learned how to optimize machine learning model performance through automated hyperparameter tuning techniques using Scikit-Learn. Gained hands-on experience with Grid Search, Random Search, Bayesian optimization, and Genetic algorithms, along with best practices for choosing and analyzing hyperparameter values.
